trigger: US-50 into Fallon: the Compact checkpoint at the canal bridge. Ross.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Fallon. Green fields gone grey. Irrigation canals still running. A checkpoint of hay bales on the canal bridge.

nodes.speaker: compact_rider
nodes.text: Truck stops there. City plates. You with the Army or the Authority?

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: He's with me. That's my son. Lift the bar, Javi.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: Let him wait a minute. ...Fine. He's my son. Lift it.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: Where are you going with a stolen airplane cart and a lady in a space suit?

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: That place. Ander's lost two riders out there. Sheep gone in the night. Something big.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: Okay. Then you don't know what took forty of Etcheverry's sheep out there either.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: Stay. One night. Your brother would like to see you. I'd... it'd be good.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: They've got Wes. The Army. In a cage at the Sparks yard. I can't get him. Can you?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wes limps out of the feed store on a crutch, grinning. 'BIG BROTHER. You brought a scientist?'

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: ...He's with you, isn't he. Wes. Of course he is. You always were his hero.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: One night. Then go do your crazy thing.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Lamb stew. A woodstove. Your father asleep in his chair at nine, like always. Some things outlast the world.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: Same as always. Go on, then.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: East of Fallon, the road crosses salt flats into a valley with no lights at all.
